mapper.select: SELECT lr.id, lr.medical_user_id, lr.leave_type, lr.start_date, lr.end_date, lr.days, lr.reason, lr.status, lr.reviewer_id, lr.review_time, lr.review_remark, lr.create_time, lr.update_time, u.username, u.real_name FROM leave_request lr LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON lr.medical_user_id = u.id WHERE lr.deleted = 0 ORDER BY lr.create_time DESC

SELECT lr.id, lr.medical_user_id, lr.leave_type, lr.start_date, lr.end_date, lr.days, lr.reason, lr.status, lr.reviewer_id, lr.review_time, lr.review_remark, lr.create_time, lr.update_time, u.username, u.real_name FROM leave_request lr LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON lr.medical_user_id = u.id WHERE lr.deleted = 0 AND lr.status = #{status} ORDER BY lr.create_time DESC
